title: Two nontrivial solutions for a fractional p-Laplacian Kirchhoff problem with steep potential well
author: Shuwen He, Shiqing Zhang
work: Existence and asymptotic behavior of solutions for fractional p-Laplacian Kirchhoff type problems
source_version: Electronic Journal of Differential Equations, Vol. 2026 (2026), No. 15, pp. 1--19; DOI 10.58997/ejde.2026.15; published February 17, 2026; publisher version
difficulty_reason: With the fractional Sobolev Lemmas 2.1 and 2.2, the Ekeland-type Theorem 2.4 and the source-local Lemmas 3.1--3.7 together with Remark 3.4, including the truncation compactness Lemma 3.7, available as context, the counted theorem still needs a source-local construction. The author has to build the Cerami sequence of the constrained Kirchhoff functional at the mountain-pass level with the uniform bound on the sequence, apply Lemma 3.7 to obtain convergence for large lambda and small b and small norm of h, then construct the second solution by local minimisation: exhibit a direction along which the functional is negative for small positive multiples, argue that the minimum on the closed ball of radius rho is attained in the open ball, and separate the two levels through a negative value below the mountain-pass level. Controlling the three parameters b, lambda and the norm of h uniformly through the nonlocal Kirchhoff term is beyond a routine qualification problem, although the deepest compactness input is supplied by the retained context.
